scope: RO0000 pet-skill shop data with direct single-player gameplay relevance.
observations: All four endpoint data/hydata look.txt catalogs list the same genout/psks_* bindings; the corresponding endpoint argument files contain explicit skill_rate/main_msg/pet_skill payloads.
The four entries provide materially different skill catalogs by location; these are gameplay data and should not be globally merged into one shop list.

The Fixed-C PetSkillShop implementation reads the NPC argstr pet_skill list, resolves each skill through PETSKILL_getPetskillArray, hides illegal skills, and charges the configured skill cost multiplied by skill_rate.
The Fixed-C template is PetSkillShop, not FreePetSkillShop, for npcgen_petskillshop instances.

unresolvedBinding.lookCatalogAnomaly: look.txt lists freeshop/*.arg paths, but direct fetch of freeshop02.arg has a payload with skill 652,12,13,151,152,52 while look.txt advertises skill 210 for that path.
unresolvedBinding.policy: Do not treat the look.txt entry alone as live binding; preserve the anomaly until an exact NPC create/template-to-arg admission path is found.
